title: HTTP/3 WebSocket Tunnel Close Echo Verification
verification_method: Focused HTTP/3 loopback test, RFC 9220 parser regression tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene.
scope: This verification covers an accepted websocket Extended CONNECT tunnel whose application handler reads a masked client close frame through `Http3WebSocketTunnelContext`, validates the close status and reason, writes an unmasked echoed close frame, and completes the writable side of the stream with FIN. It also keeps the previous handler-dispatch and parser tests in the focused filter.
preconditions: The RFC 9220 Extended CONNECT foundation remains trace-owned by `VER-QUIC-RFC9220-0001`.
The WebSocket frame parser remains trace-owned by `VER-QUIC-RFC9220-0002`.
The WebSocket handler dispatch boundary remains trace-owned by `VER-QUIC-RFC9220-0003`.
expected_result: The focused loopback and parser tests pass, the new RFC 9220 close echo requirement is trace-clean, SpecTrace validation accepts the artifacts, and diff hygiene is clean.
status_summary: The HTTP/3 server handler path now has locally verified WebSocket close echo and orderly write completion on accepted RFC 9220 tunnels. Evidence class is local same-process loopback over the repository QUIC transport; it is not external peer interoperability, published ProtocolLab evidence, or isolated-host proof.
